overrides.name: Kingsoft Corp Ltd
overrides.note: Was 3K1.SG - Stuttgart, EUR, median EUR 6,550/day - for a Hong Kong company. An ACWI constituent whose price series came off a German line doing a few thousand euro a day, and whose region therefore read Europe. Escaped repoint_primary_listing.py because Yahoo returns no profile for that line, so it has no market cap and the ADV/cap detector never looked at it.

overrides.name: Li Ning Co Ltd
overrides.note: Was LNLB.SG - Stuttgart, EUR, median EUR 2,594/day. Same failure as Kingsoft: an ACWI constituent priced off a German line, read as Europe on the region axis. Cayman-incorporated, so neither the domicile nor the ISIN prefix is a market - the venue was the only signal left and it was the wrong venue.

overrides.name: Orient Overseas (International) Ltd
overrides.note: Was ORI1.MU - Munich, EUR, median EUR 3,056/day. Bermuda-incorporated Hong Kong shipping line; the Munich listing put it in Europe on both the region axis and its own price series.

overrides.name: Postal Savings Bank of China Co Ltd H
overrides.note: The held AIRS security is the Hong Kong H share, not the separately listed Shanghai A share (CNE100003PZ4 / 601658.SS). Automatic resolution marked the H-share ISIN not_found; pinning Yahoo 1658.HK restores its own sector and price history without borrowing another share class.

overrides.name: Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co Ltd
overrides.note: The ACWI workbook holds the Taiwan ordinary share under ticker 2330 on the Taiwan Stock Exchange. Automatic resolution attached this ISIN to the US ADR symbol TSM, so the workbook's exact 2330.TW membership could not resolve and Attribution marked the ADR holding as outside ACWI. Pinning the ordinary ISIN to its own liquid Yahoo listing preserves the security identity while the existing company-level overlap matcher can relate the ordinary share and ADR by their common company name.

overrides.name: Ferrovial N.V.
overrides.note: The ACWI workbook holds Ferrovial under ticker FER on Bolsa de Madrid, which maps to Yahoo FER.MC. Automatic resolution selected the obscure 0P2N.IL line instead, so the workbook's exact ticker-and-venue membership could not resolve even though both the held security and the workbook row identify ISIN NL0015001FS8.
